name: Media Folders
description: This module provides a better UI for managing and selecting Media entities in a folder structure.
project_description:
This module provides a better UI for managing and selecting Media entities in a folder structure. 

 This folder structure is a Taxonomy vocabulary and is not reflected in the physical location of the files.

 The module offers a "windows explorer" style navigation UI, with drag an drop to move things around e drag to upload new files.

 
 Featured module of the week by Talking Drupal 

 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n-kb0_R-xOQ 

 
 

 
 Back to top 

 Features 
 
 Smart file uploads (files are automatically assigned to Media bundles) 
 Drag to upload 
 Drag and drop to move 
 Multiple view modes and sorts 
 Search filter inside folders 
 Recursive folder search 
 Form display widget for easy Media selection 
 View display widget for managing multiple bundle presentation 
 CKEditor plugin 
 Compatible with other filesystem modules (ex: S3 File System ) 
 
 
 Back to top 

 Installation 
 
 Install as you would normally install a contributed Drupal module. For further

information, see Installing Drupal Modules. 
 
 Back to top 

 Post-Installation 
 
 Once you've enabled the module, go to "/admin/content/media-folders" 
 Select and configure the "Media Folders" widget on your media reference fields 
 
 Back to top 

 Similar Modules 
 
 Media Folder Management - Same UI, mas supplies its own "media" entity and each folder has its own CRUD permissions 
 Media Directories - Same purpose, mas with dependencies and fewer features
